text.content: What the Custom Function Node does

rich_text.plain_text: What the Custom Function Node does

text.content: The Custom Function Node provides a mechanism for executing custom server-side JavaScript code within the workflow. It allows writing and running arbitrary JavaScript snippets, offering an effective way to implement complex data transformations, bespoke business logic, or interactions with resources not directly supported by other standard nodes.

rich_text.plain_text: The Custom Function Node provides a mechanism for executing custom server-side JavaScript code within the workflow. It allows writing and running arbitrary JavaScript snippets, offering an effective way to implement complex data transformations, bespoke business logic, or interactions with resources not directly supported by other standard nodes.

text.content: In practical terms: When the visual nodes cannot do what the workflow needs, the Custom Function Node fills the gap with code.

text.content: The output socket of the Custom Function Node always produces a string. If a downstream node expects a number or a parsed object, the transformation must happen in that downstream node, not in the Custom Function Node's return value.

text.content: Takeaway:

rich_text.plain_text: Takeaway:

text.content: The Custom Function Node is the escape hatch for logic that the visual node palette cannot handle. It is powerful precisely because it is unrestricted. That power comes with one firm limitation: always return a string. Every other node on the canvas expects string output from the Custom Function Node, and silent type mismatches are one of the harder failure modes to diagnose in a running flow.
